mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, s.SIMULATION_ID AS simulationId, fs.CURRENT_PREP_MONTHS AS currentPrepMonths, s.EXPECT_PREP_MONTHS AS expectPrepMonths, ep.TARGET_EMPLOYMENT_DATE AS targetEmploymentDate, ep.LIVING_FUND_THRESHOLD AS livingFundThreshold FROM USER u LEFT JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep ON u.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SNAPSHOT fs ON fs.SNAPSHOT_ID = ( SELECT SNAPSHOT_ID FROM SNAPSHOT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_BASE_DATE DESC, SNAPSHOT_CREATED_AT DESC, SNAPSHOT_ID DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN SIMULATION s ON s.SIMULATION_ID = ( SELECT SIMULATION_ID FROM SIMULATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY (CASE WHEN CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), SIMULATION_ID DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
